def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    net_earnings = 220000
    social_security_cap = 160200
    social_security_rate = 0.124
    medicare_rate = 0.029
    additional_medicare_threshold = 200000
    additional_medicare_rate = 0.009

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    social_security_tax = min(net_earnings, social_security_cap) * social_security_rate
    medicare_tax = net_earnings * medicare_rate
    additional_medicare_tax = max(
        0,
        net_earnings - additional_medicare_threshold
    ) * additional_medicare_rate

    total_seca_tax = (
        social_security_tax
        + medicare_tax
        + additional_medicare_tax
    )

    # return answer
    return round(total_seca_tax, 2)
